parts.gloss: to those who do not have

words.gloss: to those who do not have

literal: To those without capital, profit is not; to those who do not have support which is a prop, there is no stability.
translation: Just as there is no profit for those without capital, there is no stability for those who lack the supporting pillar of great allies.
modern: முதலீடு இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு லாபம் கிடைக்காதது போல, தமக்கு ஆதரவாக இருக்கும் பெரியவர்களின் துணை இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு வாழ்க்கையில் நிலைத்தன்மை இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet uses a simple analogy from commerce to explain the importance of strong allies. Just as a business cannot yield profit without an initial capital investment, a person cannot maintain stability without the solid support of wise and great people. The word 'மதலை' means a prop or a supporting pillar, emphasizing that such allies bear the weight of one's responsibilities.
